nameParsed.literal: Tarabella Middleton, Mike Parkes, Miguel Rivera, and Python in Chemistry

authors.name: Tarabella Middleton, Mike Parkes, Miguel Rivera, and Python in Chemistry

children.value: Until now, we have learned how to give simple instructions to Python, who exectues them all, in order, from top to bottom. In this chapter, we discover how to control the execution of Python so that the commands don’t necessarily flow top to bottom but in any order we like, based on pre-set conditions and repeating pieces of code as much as we like.
